import io

import pytest

import flask


def test_filename_keyword():
    app = flask.Flask(__name__)
    with app.test_request_context():
        rv = flask.send_file(io.BytesIO(b"x"), mimetype="text/plain", as_attachment=True, filename="a.txt")
        assert "a.txt" in rv.headers["Content-Disposition"]
        rv.close()
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            flask.send_file(io.BytesIO(b"x"), mimetype="text/plain", download_name="a.txt")

import flask


def test_send_text():
    app = flask.Flask(__name__)
    with app.test_request_context():
        rv = flask.send_text("hello", "notes.txt")
        rv.direct_passthrough = False
        assert rv.get_data() == b"hello"
        assert "notes.txt" in rv.headers["Content-Disposition"]
        assert rv.mimetype == "text/plain"
        rv.close()
